notes: open, call of an EU-funded project
summary: The Open Call for New Ventures in Creative Tech (Spark) supports early-stage founders and multidisciplinary teams in transforming validated business concepts into new, scalable and legally established ventures. Applicants should already be testing, building or validating their business concept and must not have an existing registered company implementing the concept submitted under the call.
